title: Emitted-path config-reference misses nested entries when rootDir is unset

expectedChecks.reason: package.json script 'node app/dist/src/run.js' names the emitted path of the moved app/src/run.ts

notes: The confirmer's TS-version-independent repro (app/tsconfig.json without rootDir, script names app/dist/src/run.js); the reported packages/cli case relies on TS 5 emit semantics.
